entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Gerald Eugene Wilkerson is an American prelate of the Roman Catholic Church. He served as an auxiliary bishop of the Archdiocese of Los Angeles in California from 1997 to 2015 and as apostolic administrator for the Diocese of Monterey in California for six months in 2018 and 2019.
